newsitem.title: USA: KCBT raises some natgas futures margins Wed.
newsitem.headline: KCBT raises some natgas futures margins Wed.

text.p: The Kansas City Board of Trade said it raised some of its minimum margins for trading western natural gas futures, effective today, due to increased market volatility.

Initial margin will be raised to $1,875 from $1,400 for speculative accounts; to $1,875 from $1,400 for hedge accounts; to $1,500 from $1,000 for omnibus accounts; and to $1,500 from $1,100 for member-for-own accounts.

Maintenance margin will be raised to $1,500 from $1,000 for speculative accounts; to $1,500 from $1,000 for hedge accounts; to $1,500 from $1,000 for omnibus accounts; and to $1,500 from $1,000 for member-for-own accounts.
